sources.label: Patches for morphe
sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Disable cloud sign-in prompt

Keeps the optional Microsoft cloud sign-in onboarding from replacing SwiftKey's launcher, so local keyboard setup and settings remain usable without an account. This does not sign in or unlock cloud sync and other account-backed features.
Disable telemetry

Stops SwiftKey's first-party telemetry records and uploads, Adjust attribution, Crashlytics, Firebase Sessions, legacy Google Analytics, and app exception reporting. Push messaging and the multipurpose job service stay enabled.

sources.author: M1zir’s SwiftKey Clipboard
patch_list: Customise toolbar

Adds a local toolbar editor to SwiftKey settings. Choose and reorder shortcuts; the native Reorder items button opens it too. Choose fewer or more shortcuts; native layout distributes visible icons and More options remains available.
Disable cloud sign-in prompt

Disable telemetry

Stops SwiftKey's first-party telemetry records and uploads, Adjust attribution, Crashlytics, Firebase Sessions, legacy Google Analytics, and app exception reporting. Push messaging and the multipurpose job service stay enabled.
Keep clipboard history forever

Keeps local clipboard entries beyond one hour until you delete them. Preserves pinning and manual deletion, and fixes sorting of entries weeks apart. No artificial local history count limit is added; storage and memory remain finite. Does…
Restore Arabic 123 legacy layout

Restores the Arabic 123 legacy arrangement with و as the third bottom-row letter and no separate ؤ key. Keeps the current layouts and default selection. Select the restored layout in SwiftKey Languages.
